title: Sustainable valorization of peach palm (Bactris gasipaes Kunth) peel flour to improve nutritional properties and carotenoid bioaccessibility in gluten-free cookies
content:
Sustainable Food Technol., 2026, 4,2657-2667
DOI: 10.1039/D5FB00751H, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Jhonathan Vinícius Menezes Silva, Allien Monique Rosa Machado, Andressa Mara Baseggio, Renan Campos Chisté, Lilian Regina Barros Mariutti
This study formulated gluten-free cookies by replacing rice flour with peach palm peel flour (PF) at 10 and 20%, and evaluated their physical, nutritional, and carotenoid composition, as well as in vitro bioaccessibility.
